Module  java.base
Software package  java.lang

Class StringBuffer

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.StringBuffer
  • All implemented interfaces
    Serializable ， Appendable ， CharSequence ， Comparable<StringBuffer> 
    public final class StringBuffer
extends Object
implements Serializable, Comparable<StringBuffer>, CharSequence
    A thread-safe, mutable sequence of characters. A string buffer is similar toString, but can be modified. At any point in time it contains some specific sequence of characters, but the length and content of the sequence can be changed by certain method calls.

    String buffers are safe for use by multiple threads. TheseMethodsInmustwantwhenenterlinesame步, in order toconvenientany特decideExampleTopofAllOperationallTablepresent得OKliketheywith某itemsstringlineSequenceAppear，这andplace涉andofeachseparatelyThreadplaceenterOf the lineMethodsCallofSequenceconsistent.

    StringBufferThe main operation on it isappendandinsertmethods, which are overloaded to accept any type of data. Each effectively converts the given data to a string, and then appends or inserts the characters of that string into the string buffer. appendThe method always appends these characters at the end of the buffer; insertThe method adds characters at the specified point.

    For example, ifzRefers to its current content as"start"of the string buffer object, then the method callz.append("le")will cause the string buffer to contain"startle", whereasz.insert(4, "le")Will change the string buffer so that it contains"starlet" 。

    In general, if one is referring to an instanceStringBuffer, thensb.append(x)has the same effectsb.insert(sb.length(), x) 。

    Whenever an operation involving a source sequence occurs (such as appending or inserting from the source sequence), this class synchronizes only on the string buffer performing the operation, not on the source. Note that althoughStringBufferDesigned to be safely used by multiple threads concurrently, but if the constructor orappendorinsertIf the operation is passed a source sequence that is shared across threads, the calling code must ensure that the operation has a consistent and immutable view of the source sequence for the duration of the operation. This can be satisfied by a caller holding a lock during the operation invocation, by using immutable source sequences, or by not sharing source sequences across threads.

    Each string buffer has a capacity. As long as the length of the character sequence contained in this string buffer does not exceed the capacity, it is not necessary to allocate a new internal buffer array. If the internal buffer overflows, it automatically becomes larger.

    Unless otherwise specified, it willnullparameter passed tonullthe constructor or method in ... will cause ... to be thrown.NullPointerException 。

    Since JDK 5, this class has been supplemented with an equivalent class designed for a single thread.StringBuilder 。 should generally be preferredStringBuilderclass, because it supports all the same operations, but is faster because it does not perform synchronization.

        public StringBuffer reverse()
        This character sequence is caused by the reverse replacement of the sequence. If the sequence contains any surrogate pairs, these surrogate pairs are treated as a single character for the reverse operation. Therefore, the order of high and low surrogates will never be reversed. designnis performedreversethe character length of this character sequence before the method (notcharthe length in the value). Then, the index in the new character sequencekthe character at ... is equal to the character at index ... in the old character sequence.nk-1character at.

        Note that the reverse operation may result in producing surrogate pairs that were unpaired low and high surrogates before the operation. For example, reversing “\ uDC00 \ uD800” generates “\ uD800 \ uDC00”, which is a valid surrogate pair.
